name: iTrain Flagger
summary:
iTrain Flagger is an immersive virtual reality training simulation developed specifically for the Missouri Department of Transportation (MoDOT). Designed to enhance worker safety and public transit efficiency, the application places trainees directly into realistic work zones to practice standardized traffic flagging procedures.
